title: Geodetic sets for directed acyclic planar geodetic graphs
summary: A set of vertices $S$ of a directed graph $G$ is geodetic if every vertex of $G$ lies on a shortest path from a vertex of $S$ to a vertex of $S$. A directed graph is geodetic if there is at most one shortest path from every vertex of $G$ to every vertex of $G$. We prove the NP-completeness of the following decision problem. Given a directed acyclic planar geodetic graph $G$ and an integer $k$, does $G$ have a geodetic set with at most $k$ vertices?
